objectives.description: Identify and produce pure vowel sounds (monophthongs) in isolation and in connected speech
Identify and produce diphthong sounds including /eɪ/, /oʊ/, /aɪ/, /aʊ/, /ɔɪ/, /ɪə/, /eə/, /ʊə/
Identify and contrast consonant sounds including fricatives /θ/, /ð/, /ʃ/, /ʧ/, /w/, /j/ in minimal pairs
Identify word stress patterns and apply correct stress in polysyllabic words
Apply appropriate intonation patterns (rising and falling) in statements, questions, and commands
Produce consonant clusters correctly in words and connected speech
Demonstrate awareness of word boundaries and linking sounds in natural speech
Identify and use nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs correctly in sentences
Apply verb tenses (present, past, future) and concord correctly in oral and written expression
Use conjunctions including 'although', 'whereas', 'despite', and 'in spite of' to create complex sentences
Form and use active and passive voice constructions appropriately
Identify and use synonyms, antonyms, and causative verbs to enrich vocabulary
Construct tag questions and differentiate between polar and tag questions
Use prefixes, suffixes, and adverbs of place to expand word knowledge and sentence variety
Read and identify main ideas, topic sentences, and supporting details in passages
Apply skimming and scanning strategies to locate specific information in texts
Infer the author's purpose, tone, and attitude from contextual clues in passages
Identify keywords and signal expressions that redirect attention to the main point of a passage
Build and use vocabulary in thematic areas including transportation, religion, and conflict resolution
Read to evaluate content and distinguish between fact and opinion in texts
Write narrative essays with clear plot, setting, characters, and sequence of events
Write expository essays on familiar topics with organized paragraphs and supporting details
Write argumentative essays presenting a clearly stated position supported by logical arguments
Write formal letters (to an authority, official, or institution) with correct format and register
Write informal letters (to a friend or family member) with appropriate tone and format
Write a well-structured summary that captures the key ideas of a given passage concisely
Write dialogues with correct punctuation, appropriate register, and realistic exchange of ideas
Write report texts on observed events with accurate, objective, and organized information
Identify themes, characterization, plot, and setting in recommended prose texts
Analyse dialogue, dramatic action, and stagecraft elements in recommended drama texts
Identify and interpret figurative language including simile, metaphor, alliteration, irony, and pun in poetry
Distinguish between myths, legends, and folktales and identify their moral lessons
Write a short original poem, play extract, or story using literary devices
